cost.why: every request replays from the committed cache; the real client is never built offline

all_relevant.what: The scorer marks every article relevant (score floored at 0.6).

no_diversity.what: Skips the diversity stage (_enforce_diversity returns its input).

proto_no_forced.what: Prototype assembly ignores forced world-critical event slots.

proto_rotate_bodies.what: Prototype judge: verdict bodies shift one slot while each echoed id stays put, which defeats the id-keyed join.

proto_rotate_list.what: Prototype judge: the whole verdict list rotates, ids travelling with their bodies. The id-keyed join should make this a no-op.

reverse_feed.what: Reverses the final ranked feed, so the worst-ranked articles fill the top 12.

reverse_top_k.what: Reverses the order inside the top 12 only. Every metric is a set over the top 12, so this is predicted invisible by construction.

rotate_verdicts.what: Replays the list-position bug: each batch's verdict bodies shift one slot, so every article is judged by its neighbour's verdict. Any article id stays in place.

swap_labels.what: Grades persona i against persona i+1's labels: the ground truth is wrong, the feed is not.

gate_control.expect: offline_misses_total > 0, so the gate's offline check fails
gate_control.name: drop_plants_prefilter
offline_violations: 3 raised cache misses (a changed request fell back instead of replaying)
